name: ptee-applyonforward-host-firewall
title: Firewall forwarded traffic: applyOnForward
summary: Lesson 82 firewalled a node's own traffic. This firewalls the traffic a node *forwards*: a GlobalNetworkPolicy with applyOnForward on a wildcard HostEndpoint polices every flow that transits the host on its way to a workload - so one cluster-wide rule can quarantine an entire class of pods (app == 'database'), below and independent of any NetworkPolicy.
